ability.name: Alarm
ability.notes: Wards an area and alerts when creatures intrude; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Animal Messenger
ability.notes: Noncombat message-delivery spell; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Arcane Lock
ability.notes: Locks an object; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Acid Splash
ability.notes: Can target two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

ability.name: Arcane Eye
ability.notes: Creates an invisible scouting eye; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Animate Dead
ability.notes: Summons a skeleton or zombie under control for 24 hours; creature statistics handled separately.

ability.name: Antimagic Field
ability.notes: Suppresses spells, magical effects, magic items, summoned creatures, and magical travel within the moving sphere.

ability.name: Animal Shapes
ability.notes: Transforms willing allies into beasts; beast statistics and unlimited targets are approximated.

ability.name: Acid Arrow
ability.notes: Miss deals half initial damage and no recurring damage; recurring damage occurs at end of target's next turn.

ability.name: Animal Friendship
ability.notes: Only affects beasts with Intelligence below 4; ends if caster or companions harm the target.

ability.name: Alter Self
ability.notes: Captures natural weapon bonuses; aquatic adaptation and appearance changes are omitted.

ability.name: Antilife Shell
ability.notes: Creates a moving barrier that prevents living creatures from passing through or reaching through it.

ability.name: Aid
ability.notes: Modeled hit point increase as temporary hit points; maximum hit point increase is not represented.

ability.name: Arcane Sword
ability.notes: Bonus action moves the sword up to 20 feet and repeats the melee spell attack.

ability.name: Animate Objects
ability.notes: Summons up to ten objects; attack statistics vary by object size and are not fully represented.

ability.name: Augury
ability.notes: Provides divination about a planned course of action; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Astral Projection
ability.notes: Planar travel and suspended animation have no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
ability.notes: Models antipathy; sympathy's compelled approach is approximated as frightened avoidance.

ability.name: Arcane Hand
ability.notes: Captures clenched fist; forceful, grasping, crushing, and interposing options are approximated.

ability.name: Arcanist's Magic Aura
ability.notes: Illusion alters divination results; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Banishment
ability.notes: Target returns when concentration ends unless native to another plane and banished for the full duration.

ability.name: Awaken
ability.notes: Awakens a beast or plant and charms it for 30 days.

ability.name: Barkskin
ability.notes: AC is set to a minimum of 16; represented as AC 16.

ability.name: Blight
ability.notes: Plant-specific disadvantage, maximum damage, and nonmagical plant interaction are approximated.

ability.name: Blindness/Deafness
ability.notes: Deafened option is approximated as blinded because deafened is unavailable.

ability.name: Black Tentacles
ability.notes: Restrained targets escape with an action check, not represented.

ability.name: Blade Barrier
ability.notes: Cover and difficult terrain omitted; wall represented as a 100-foot line.

ability.name: Bestow Curse
ability.notes: One of four curse effects must be selected; curse options are approximated as a generic debuff.

ability.name: Beacon of Hope
ability.notes: Advantage on Wisdom and death saves and maximum healing are not fully represented by the buff schema.

ability.name: Branding Smite
ability.notes: Adds radiant damage to next weapon hit and reveals target; invisibility prevention approximated as outlined.

ability.name: Blur
ability.notes: Attackers relying on sight have disadvantage; disadvantage is not directly represented in the buff schema.

ability.name: Calm Emotions
ability.notes: Suppresses charm or fear, or creates temporary indifference; these effects are not directly represented.

ability.name: Blink
ability.notes: Ethereal phasing and end-turn activation are not directly represented.

ability.name: Chain Lightning
ability.notes: Upcast adds one additional target per slot level above 6th.

ability.name: Call Lightning
ability.notes: Stormy conditions can add 1d10 damage; omitted because no conditional field exists.

ability.name: Charm Person
ability.notes: Target has advantage on save if you or companions are fighting it; charm ends after harmful behavior.

ability.name: Chill Touch
ability.notes: Anti-healing and undead-only disadvantage are not represented by available fields.

ability.name: Clairvoyance
ability.notes: Creates a remote sensory sensor; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Comprehend Languages
ability.notes: No meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Commune
ability.notes: Provides noncombat divine answers to up to three yes-or-no questions.

ability.name: Commune With Nature
ability.notes: Non-combat divination providing environmental knowledge.

ability.name: Clone
ability.notes: Creates a backup body; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Cloudkill
ability.notes: Fog movement and heavy obscurement are approximated by the persistent recurring area effect.

ability.name: Color Spray
ability.notes: Blinds creatures by ascending hit points until the 6d10 pool is exhausted.

ability.name: Command
ability.notes: Models commands that end the target's turn as incapacitation; other command options vary.

ability.name: Cone of Cold
ability.notes: Frozen statue effect on creatures killed is not modeled.

ability.name: Conjure Elemental
ability.notes: Summons a CR 5 or lower elemental; higher slots increase its challenge rating by 1 per level.

ability.name: Conjure Animals
ability.notes: Represents the maximum eight-beast option; summoned creature statistics and other options are not modeled.

ability.name: Conjure Celestial
ability.notes: Summons one celestial of CR 4 or lower; summoned creature's statistics and actions are not specified.

ability.name: Continual Flame
ability.notes: Creates a noncombat flame with torch brightness.

ability.name: Compulsion
ability.notes: Approximates forced directional movement as slowed; targets may be designated among creatures within range.

ability.name: Conjure Fey
ability.notes: Summons one friendly fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower with its own turns.

ability.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
ability.notes: Summons one CR 2, two CR 1, four CR 1/2, or eight CR 1/4 fey; creature statistics vary.

ability.name: Confusion
ability.notes: Approximates variable behavior as incapacitated; target still has a chance to act normally.

ability.name: Control Weather
ability.notes: Primarily narrative weather manipulation; no direct combat effect is represented.

ability.name: Contingency
ability.notes: Stores a self-targeted spell triggered by a specified circumstance; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Create Food and Water
ability.notes: Creates nourishing food and clean water; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Create or Destroy Water
ability.notes: Creates or destroys water; rain or fog effects have no combat impact.

ability.name: Counterspell
ability.notes: Interrupts a spell; higher-level spells require a spellcasting ability check.

ability.name: Cure Wounds
ability.notes: Restores 1d8 plus spellcasting modifier; has no effect on undead or constructs.

ability.name: Dancing Lights
ability.notes: Creates mobile lights; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
ability.notes: Summoned elemental statistics and choice-dependent creature counts are approximated.

ability.name: Create Undead
ability.notes: Animates up to three Medium or Small humanoid corpses as ghouls under control for 24 hours.

ability.name: Daylight
ability.notes: Illumination and dispels lower-level darkness; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Darkvision
ability.notes: Grants 60-foot darkvision; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Creation
ability.notes: Creates a nonliving object; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Detect Poison and Disease
ability.notes: Detects poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Contact Other Plane
ability.notes: Noncombat information spell; one-minute casting time and self-risk are not modeled.

ability.name: Darkness
ability.notes: Creates magical darkness that blocks sight; visibility penalties are approximated without a dedicated obscured condition.

ability.name: Detect Evil and Good
ability.notes: Detects certain creature types and consecrated or desecrated locations; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
ability.notes: Accumulated 1d6-per-turn damage increase is not represented.

ability.name: Demiplane
ability.notes: Creates an extradimensional door; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Contagion
ability.notes: Disease choices and three-success or three-failure progression approximated as poisoned with recurring Constitution saves.

ability.name: Death Ward
ability.notes: Prevents one drop to 0 hit points or instant death; simulator lacks a death-protection buff field.

ability.name: Detect Magic
ability.notes: Detects magic and magical auras; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Detect Thoughts
ability.notes: Detects or reads thoughts; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Disguise Self
ability.notes: Illusion and disguise provide no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Divination
ability.notes: Provides truthful divination; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Control Water
ability.notes: Whirlpool damage and being caught are approximated as recurring restrained area control.

ability.name: Dispel Magic
ability.notes: Ends magical effects; higher-level spell removal checks are abstracted.

ability.name: Disintegrate
ability.notes: Object and disintegration effects are represented by the single-target force damage save.

ability.name: Druidcraft
ability.notes: Harmless sensory and natural effects; no meaningful combat impact.

ability.name: Dimension Door
ability.notes: Teleports caster and one willing creature; destination and failed teleport damage are abstracted.

ability.name: Dominate Beast
ability.notes: Damage prompts new Wisdom saves; precise control and telepathic commands are approximated.

ability.name: Dominate Monster
ability.notes: Damage allows a new Wisdom save; precise control and telepathic commands are approximated.

ability.name: Dominate Person
ability.notes: Charmed target obeys commands; damage triggers a new Wisdom save rather than ending automatically.

ability.name: Enhance Ability
ability.notes: Captures Bear's Endurance temporary hit points; other options grant noncombat ability-check advantages.

ability.name: Divine Word
ability.notes: HP thresholds, blindness, deafness, instant death, and creature-type banishment are approximated as long-duration stun.

ability.name: Earthquake
ability.notes: Recurring prone saves represented; concentration breaks, fissures, structures, and collapse damage omitted.

ability.name: Entangle
ability.notes: Difficult terrain and action-based Strength escape check are not represented.

ability.name: Fabricate
ability.notes: Non-combat object creation spell with a 10-minute casting time.

ability.name: Dream
ability.notes: Delayed damage and sleep deprivation are approximated; no direct combat condition applies.

ability.name: Expeditious Retreat
ability.notes: Grants Dash as a bonus action each turn; movement benefit is approximated.

ability.name: Dispel Evil and Good
ability.notes: Protective disadvantage against specified creature types is approximated; break enchantment and dismissal are omitted.

ability.name: Enthrall
ability.notes: Disadvantage on Perception checks is approximated as a debuff without a direct simulator field.

ability.name: Etherealness
ability.notes: Caster becomes ethereal, untargetable and intangible; simulator approximates this as a long-duration buff.

ability.name: Fireball
ability.notes: Fire spreads around corners and ignites unattended flammable objects.

ability.name: Faithful Hound
ability.notes: Summoned hound automatically attacks one hostile creature within 5 feet at the start of each caster turn.

ability.name: Enlarge/Reduce
ability.notes: Models Enlarge's +1d4 weapon damage; Reduce's penalties and Strength check/save advantage are omitted.

ability.name: Feather Fall
ability.notes: Prevents falling damage; no meaningful direct combat effect.

ability.name: Fear
ability.notes: Frightened movement and dropping held items are approximated; saving throw ends effect when line of sight is broken.

ability.name: False Life
ability.notes: Grants temporary hit points; higher-level flat bonuses omitted because this is the base-level effect.

ability.name: Find Traps
ability.notes: Detects traps but provides no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Find the Path
ability.notes: Provides navigation guidance; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Finger of Death
ability.notes: Humanoid kills create a permanently commanded zombie; not represented.

ability.name: Fire Storm
ability.notes: Represents up to ten adjoining 10-foot cubes as a 100-foot cube area.

ability.name: Feeblemind
ability.notes: Failed save reduces Intelligence and Charisma to 1 and prevents spellcasting, language, communication, and magic item use.

ability.name: Eyebite
ability.notes: Frightened approximates Panicked; Asleep and Sickened options are omitted.

ability.name: Find Steed
ability.notes: Summons a chosen steed; variable stat block, telepathy, and mounted spell-sharing are approximated.

ability.name: Fire Shield
ability.notes: Choose fire or cold damage resistance and retaliation type when cast.

ability.name: Floating Disk
ability.notes: Creates a movable force disk for carrying weight; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Flame Strike
ability.notes: Cylinder is 10-foot radius and 40 feet high; upcast increases either fire or radiant damage.

ability.name: Find Familiar
ability.notes: Summons a nonattacking familiar and enables scouting or delivering touch spells.

ability.name: Fly
ability.notes: Grants 60-foot flight; movement benefit is approximated because flight is not represented in the ability schema.

ability.name: Flesh to Stone
ability.notes: Three failed saves cause petrification; three successes end the spell.

ability.name: Freezing Sphere
ability.notes: Optional delayed globe and freezing-water effects omitted.

ability.name: Flaming Sphere
ability.notes: Bonus-action movement and ramming are abstracted into recurring automatic area damage.

ability.name: Fog Cloud
ability.notes: Creates heavily obscured area; vision effects are approximated as utility.

ability.name: Gate
ability.notes: Creates a planar portal; transportation and creature-drawing effects are not represented in combat.

ability.name: Flame Blade
ability.notes: Casting is a bonus action, but the melee spell attack normally requires a separate action.

ability.name: Freedom of Movement
ability.notes: Prevents magical speed reduction and paralysis or restraint; escape and underwater benefits are approximated.

ability.name: Glibness
ability.notes: Improves Charisma checks and defeats truth-detection magic; no meaningful direct combat effect.

ability.name: Gentle Repose
ability.notes: Protects a corpse from decay and prevents undeath; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Foresight
ability.notes: Also grants advantage on checks and saves, prevents surprise, and imposes disadvantage on attacks against target.

ability.name: Giant Insect
ability.notes: Transforms up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion; summoned creatures use their own statistics.

ability.name: Forcecage
ability.notes: Approximates confinement as restrained; teleportation escape Charisma save is not modeled.

ability.name: Gaseous Form
ability.notes: Grants nonmagical physical resistance; flight and saving throw advantages are not fully represented.

ability.name: Forbiddance
ability.notes: Radiant damage shown; caster chooses radiant or necrotic and affected creature types.

ability.name: Geas
ability.notes: Recurring damage is approximated as automatic; actual damage occurs only when commands are violated, once per day.

ability.name: Greater Restoration
ability.notes: Removes exhaustion, charm, petrification, curses, ability score reductions, or hit point maximum reductions.

ability.name: Globe of Invulnerability
ability.notes: Blocks spells of 5th level or lower from outside the 10-foot sphere; higher-level scaling is not represented.

ability.name: Guidance
ability.notes: Improves one ability check, not meaningfully represented in combat.

ability.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
ability.notes: Creates a terrain illusion with no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Goodberry
ability.notes: Creates ten berries; each restores 1 hit point when eaten as an action.

ability.name: Greater Invisibility
ability.notes: Grants advantage on attacks; invisibility's disadvantage for attacks against target is not directly represented.

ability.name: Guards and Wards
ability.notes: Primarily protects a structure with multiple magical wards; combat effects are too varied for one ability.

ability.name: Guiding Bolt
ability.notes: Outlined grants advantage to the next attack against the target.

ability.name: Guardian of Faith
ability.notes: Guardian vanishes after dealing 60 total damage; persistence and hostile-only targeting are approximated.

ability.name: Gust of Wind
ability.notes: Pushes failed saves 15 feet; movement penalty and 10-foot width are not represented.

ability.name: Harm
ability.notes: Damage cannot reduce HP below 1; failed save also reduces hit point maximum for 1 hour.

ability.name: Grease
ability.notes: Recurring saves model creatures entering or ending turns in the grease; prone duration is approximated per round.

ability.name: Heal
ability.notes: Also ends blindness, deafness, and diseases; no effect on constructs or undead.

ability.name: Haste
ability.notes: Advantage on Dexterity saves and doubled speed are not represented; extra action is limited to one weapon attack or listed actions.

ability.name: Healing Word
ability.notes: Does not affect undead or constructs.

ability.name: Glyph of Warding
ability.notes: Represents explosive runes; damage type is chosen when created, and the glyph triggers later.

ability.name: Hold Monster
ability.notes: No effect on undead; additional targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

ability.name: Heroism
ability.notes: Grants frightened immunity and refreshes temporary hit points each turn; immunity is not directly represented.

ability.name: Illusory Script
ability.notes: Non-combat writing illusion; casting time approximated as an action.

ability.name: Holy Aura
ability.notes: Advantage on allies' saving throws and disadvantage on attacks against them are approximated; fiend and undead blinding omitted.

ability.name: Hunter's Mark
ability.notes: Also grants advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find the marked target.

ability.name: Identify
ability.notes: One-minute casting time and noncombat information gathering are approximated as an action utility effect.

ability.name: Hallow
ability.notes: Permanent ward and selectable effects cannot be fully represented.

ability.name: Hideous Laughter
ability.notes: Also knocks target prone; damage triggers an additional Wisdom save with advantage.

ability.name: Heroes' Feast
ability.notes: Approximates poison and frightened immunity, Wisdom save advantage, and hit point maximum increase.

ability.name: Ice Storm
ability.notes: Difficult terrain from hail is not represented.

ability.name: Hypnotic Pattern
ability.notes: Also charms targets and reduces speed to 0; an ally can end the effect with an action.

ability.name: Heat Metal
ability.notes: Disadvantage and object-dropping effects are approximated through the recurring Constitution save.

ability.name: Knock
ability.notes: Unlocks or suppresses locks; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Incendiary Cloud
ability.notes: Recurring area saves captured; obscuration and cloud movement are not represented.

ability.name: Insect Plague
ability.notes: Area is lightly obscured and difficult terrain; recurring saves occur on entry or at turn end.

ability.name: Instant Summons
ability.notes: Summons a marked object; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Legend Lore
ability.notes: Provides lore and has no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Light
ability.notes: Creates light; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Jump
ability.notes: Triples jump distance; no meaningful direct combat effect.

ability.name: Imprisonment
ability.notes: Represents chaining form; other forms imprison, banish, or magically sleep the target until dispelled.

ability.name: Levitate
ability.notes: Suspends target and limits movement; unsupported aerial control is approximated without a condition.

ability.name: Lesser Restoration
ability.notes: Ends one disease or blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned condition; condition removal is not directly represented.

ability.name: Irresistible Dance
ability.notes: Restrained approximates dancing: movement constrained, attack and Dexterity save disadvantages, and attacks against target have advantage.

ability.name: Locate Animals or Plants
ability.notes: Locates a nearby beast or plant; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Locate Creature
ability.notes: Locates a familiar creature within 1,000 feet; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Invisibility
ability.notes: Models advantage on attacks; invisibility's defensive and spell-ending interactions are approximated.

ability.name: Locate Object
ability.notes: Locates a familiar or nearby type of object; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Mage Hand
ability.notes: Manipulates objects; cannot attack or carry more than 10 pounds.

ability.name: Magic Mouth
ability.notes: Non-combat message-triggering spell; duration until dispelled is not represented.

ability.name: Longstrider
ability.notes: Increases speed by 10 feet; speed bonus is not represented in the buff schema.

ability.name: Mage Armor
ability.notes: Sets base AC to 13 plus Dexterity modifier; schema approximates this as AC 13.

ability.name: Magnificent Mansion
ability.notes: Creates an extradimensional dwelling; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Major Image
ability.notes: Illusion has no standardized combat effect in this simulator.

ability.name: Magic Weapon
ability.notes: At higher slot levels, the weapon bonus increases to +2 or +3.

ability.name: Mending
ability.notes: Repairs a small break or tear in a touched object; no combat effect.

ability.name: Mass Healing Word
ability.notes: Does not affect undead or constructs.

ability.name: Magic Circle
ability.notes: Protective ward and selective creature restriction are approximated as area control.

ability.name: Meld Into Stone
ability.notes: Primarily defensive and exploratory; no meaningful combat effect modeled.

ability.name: Magic Jar
ability.notes: Possession is approximated as incapacitation; indefinite duration is represented as 10 rounds.

ability.name: Mass Cure Wounds
ability.notes: Heals up to six creatures in the sphere; undead and constructs are unaffected.

ability.name: Mass Heal
ability.notes: Restores a shared 700-hit-point pool; disease, deafness, undead, and construct restrictions are not fully represented.

ability.name: Maze
ability.notes: Target escapes by taking an action for a DC 20 Intelligence check.

ability.name: Mass Suggestion
ability.notes: Approximates magical suggestion as charmed; affected creatures follow a reasonable course of action.

ability.name: Message
ability.notes: Communication spell with no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Misty Step
ability.notes: Teleports caster up to 30 feet to a visible, unoccupied space.

ability.name: Minor Illusion
ability.notes: Creates a sound or image with no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Mirage Arcane
ability.notes: Large sensory terrain illusion; no direct combat effect is modeled.

ability.name: Meteor Swarm
ability.notes: Four 40-foot spheres; creatures in overlapping bursts are affected only once.

ability.name: Mirror Image
ability.notes: Three duplicates can redirect attacks; duplicate destruction and attack redirection are approximated.

ability.name: Move Earth
ability.notes: Reshapes dirt, sand, or clay slowly; no direct combat effect in a simple simulator.

ability.name: Pass Without Trace
ability.notes: Stealth and tracking benefits are outside this combat simulator.

ability.name: Passwall
ability.notes: Creates a temporary passage through wood, plaster, or stone; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Mind Blank
ability.notes: Psychic immunity, mind-reading and divination protection, and charm immunity approximated as psychic resistance buff.

ability.name: Nondetection
ability.notes: Protects a creature, place, or object from divination and magical scrying; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Moonbeam
ability.notes: Cylinder height is omitted because the schema stores only one area size.

ability.name: Mislead
ability.notes: Invisibility grants attack advantage; duplicate and invisibility-ending conditions are approximated.

ability.name: Planar Ally
ability.notes: Summons a celestial, elemental, or fiend; service duration and behavior depend on negotiation and payment.

ability.name: Modify Memory
ability.notes: Also incapacitates target; memory alteration and ending when targeted by another spell are omitted.

ability.name: Phantom Steed
ability.notes: Summons a fast riding mount; horse statistics and damage-ending dismissal are approximated.

ability.name: Phantasmal Killer
ability.notes: Target rerolls Wisdom at start of each turn; success ends the spell.

ability.name: Planar Binding
ability.notes: Binds a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend to service; no listed condition captures obedience.

ability.name: Prayer of Healing
ability.notes: Casting time is 10 minutes; has no effect on undead or constructs.

ability.name: Prestidigitation
ability.notes: Harmless magical trick with no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Plant Growth
ability.notes: Models overgrown terrain as slowed; terrain effect is instantaneous and normally persists.

ability.name: Polymorph
ability.notes: Approximates transformation as incapacitated; target instead uses a beast stat block and retains actions as that form.

ability.name: Power Word Kill
ability.notes: Kills one visible target with 100 hit points or fewer; instant death is approximated as an automatic effect.

ability.name: Produce Flame
ability.notes: Hurling the flame ends the spell; it otherwise provides light.

ability.name: Private Sanctum
ability.notes: Creates a secure ward with selectable anti-divination, anti-teleportation, planar, sound, and vision protections.

ability.name: Plane Shift
ability.notes: Models hostile banishment; willing group transport is omitted.

ability.name: Programmed Illusion
ability.notes: Scripted illusion has no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Purify Food and Drink
ability.notes: Purifies food and drink; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Power Word Stun
ability.notes: Only affects creatures with 150 hit points or fewer; duration capped for simulation.

ability.name: Project Image
ability.notes: Creates an intangible illusory copy with no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Prismatic Spray
ability.notes: Random ray damage represented as possible types; indigo, violet, and special ray effects omitted.

ability.name: Protection from Poison
ability.notes: Poison neutralization and advantage on saves against poisoning are approximated by poison resistance.

ability.name: Protection from Evil and Good
ability.notes: Disadvantage and charm, fright, and possession protection are approximated due to schema limits.

ability.name: Protection From Energy
ability.notes: Grants resistance to one chosen damage type from the listed options.

ability.name: Reincarnate
ability.notes: Restores a dead humanoid in a randomly determined new body; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Remove Curse
ability.notes: Ends curses; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Prismatic Wall
ability.notes: Approximates layered wall with five damaging layers and blindness; restraining, petrification, and planar transport omitted.

ability.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
ability.notes: On hit, halves Strength-based weapon damage; target can end effect with a Constitution save each turn.

ability.name: Revivify
ability.notes: Restores a dead creature to life; resurrection is not modeled as a combat effect.

ability.name: Regenerate
ability.notes: Initial healing captured; ongoing 1 hit point per turn and limb restoration are omitted.

ability.name: Resurrection
ability.notes: Restores a dead creature to life; no meaningful effect during ordinary combat.

ability.name: Resistance
ability.notes: One saving throw only; the simulator should consume the bonus after use.

ability.name: Reverse Gravity
ability.notes: Creatures can avoid upward fall by succeeding on Dexterity save and grabbing a reachable fixed object.

ability.name: Rope Trick
ability.notes: Creates an extradimensional refuge with no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Raise Dead
ability.notes: Revives a dead creature with 1 hit point; -4 attacks, saves, and checks until reduced by long rests.

ability.name: Resilient Sphere
ability.notes: Approximates force-sphere enclosure as restrained; no repeat save or damage.

ability.name: Sacred Flame
ability.notes: Target gains no benefit from cover, which is not modeled.

ability.name: See Invisibility
ability.notes: Reveals invisible and ethereal creatures and objects; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Secret Chest
ability.notes: Stores or recalls a chest; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Shield
ability.notes: Also prevents damage from magic missile.

ability.name: Scrying
ability.notes: Divination spell with no meaningful direct combat effect.

ability.name: Sequester
ability.notes: Non-combat concealment and suspended animation; indefinite duration is not represented.

ability.name: Seeming
ability.notes: Illusory disguise with no direct combat effect; can affect any number of creatures within range.

ability.name: Sanctuary
ability.notes: Warded creature forces Wisdom saves against attacks and harmful spells; ends when it attacks or harms an enemy.

ability.name: Sending
ability.notes: Unlimited range cannot be represented; no combat effect.

ability.name: Shatter
ability.notes: Inorganic materials' disadvantage on the save is not represented.

ability.name: Shocking Grasp
ability.notes: Target cannot take reactions until its next turn; metal armor advantage is not represented.

ability.name: Silent Image
ability.notes: Purely visual illusion; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Spiritual Weapon
ability.notes: Upcast damage increases by 1d8 every two slot levels; schema cannot represent that interval.

ability.name: Shapechange
ability.notes: Transforms caster into a qualifying creature; exact replacement statistics and abilities are not represented.

ability.name: Silence
ability.notes: Suppresses sound and verbal spellcasting; deafened condition is not represented.

ability.name: Spare the Dying
ability.notes: Stabilizes a creature at 0 hit points; stabilization is not represented by the combat schema.

ability.name: Speak with Animals
ability.notes: Non-combat communication with beasts.

ability.name: Shillelagh
ability.notes: Weapon damage die becomes d8 and attacks use spellcasting ability; magical weapon property is not represented.

ability.name: Speak with Dead
ability.notes: Allows questioning a corpse; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Simulacrum
ability.notes: Creates a partially real duplicate using the target's statistics with half hit points; duplicate cannot regain spell slots or improve.

ability.name: Stone Shape
ability.notes: Shapes stone; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Sleep
ability.notes: Uses a 5d8 hit point pool, affecting lowest-current-HP creatures first; undead and charm-immune creatures are unaffected.

ability.name: Spider Climb
ability.notes: Grants climbing and ceiling movement, not represented by combat fields.

ability.name: Speak with Plants
ability.notes: Communication and terrain manipulation are not meaningfully represented in combat.

ability.name: Spike Growth
ability.notes: Recurring damage approximates movement-triggered damage; difficult terrain is not separately represented.

ability.name: Sleet Storm
ability.notes: Heavy obscurement, difficult terrain, doused flames, and concentration checks are approximated.

ability.name: Stoneskin
ability.notes: Grants resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

ability.name: Slow
ability.notes: Slowed condition approximates halved speed, no reactions, one action or bonus action, and one attack.

ability.name: Spirit Guardians
ability.notes: Evil casters deal necrotic instead of radiant; damage triggers on entering or starting turn in area.

ability.name: Suggestion
ability.notes: Approximates the compelled course of action as charmed; ends if the caster or companions damage the target.

ability.name: Telepathic Bond
ability.notes: Creates communication only; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Stinking Cloud
ability.notes: Models retching as incapacitated; heavily obscured, breathing immunity, and wind dispersal are not represented.

ability.name: Sunburst
ability.notes: Undead and oozes have disadvantage on the saving throw; spell-created darkness is dispelled.

ability.name: Telekinesis
ability.notes: Contested checks and object manipulation are approximated as a restrained target for one round.

ability.name: Thaumaturgy
ability.notes: Minor magical effects have no meaningful combat impact.

ability.name: Teleport
ability.notes: Instant transportation; mishap damage and destination accuracy are not modeled.

ability.name: Thunderwave
ability.notes: Push effect omitted because no push field exists.

ability.name: Teleportation Circle
ability.notes: Provides transportation rather than a meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Tiny Hut
ability.notes: Non-combat protective dome; casting time is approximated as an action.

ability.name: Tongues
ability.notes: Grants universal spoken-language communication; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Sunbeam
ability.notes: Undead and oozes have disadvantage on the Constitution save; sunlight illumination is not modeled.

ability.name: Transport via Plants
ability.notes: Transportation effect with no meaningful combat impact.

ability.name: Time Stop
ability.notes: Grants 1d4+1 consecutive turns; extra-turn effect is approximated due to schema limitations.

ability.name: True Strike
ability.notes: Advantage applies only to the caster's first attack against the target on the next turn.

ability.name: Symbol (Death)
ability.notes: Uses the Death option; trigger setup and alternate glyph effects are not modeled.

ability.name: Tree Stride
ability.notes: Teleportation through trees is not represented in combat effects.

ability.name: Storm of Vengeance
ability.notes: Later rounds vary by effect; acid, lightning, hail, obscurement, difficult terrain, and deafened condition are approximated or omitted.

ability.name: True Seeing
ability.notes: Truesight and magical perception are not modeled as combat effects.

ability.name: Unseen Servant
ability.notes: Creates a noncombat servant for simple tasks; cannot attack.

ability.name: True Polymorph
ability.notes: Transformation effects and permanent duration are approximated without a dedicated polymorph condition.

ability.name: True Resurrection
ability.notes: Resurrection and restoration effects are not represented in the simple combat simulator.

ability.name: Wall of Fire
ability.notes: Recurring damage and wall geometry are approximated as automatic line-area damage.

ability.name: Wall of Force
ability.notes: Creates an impassable wall; exact panel, dome, sphere, and displacement geometry is approximated.

ability.name: Vicious Mockery
ability.notes: Disadvantage on the target's next attack is not directly representable in the condition schema.

ability.name: Wall of Stone
ability.notes: Creates a durable stone barrier; enclosed creatures may save to escape, but dimensions and object durability are abstracted.

ability.name: Water Walk
ability.notes: Allows movement across liquids; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Water Breathing
ability.notes: Grants underwater breathing; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Vampiric Touch
ability.notes: Healing is approximated as 1d6; recurring attacks also restore half their necrotic damage.

ability.name: Wall of Ice
ability.notes: Models initial placement damage; breached-wall frigid-air damage is omitted.

ability.name: Wall of Thorns
ability.notes: Models the wall as a 60-foot line; circular option and movement penalty are omitted.

ability.name: Warding Bond
ability.notes: Damage sharing and range-ending conditions are not represented; resistance applies while within 60 feet.

ability.name: Wish
ability.notes: Versatile reality alteration and spell duplication cannot be represented as one fixed combat effect.

ability.name: Weird
ability.notes: Recurring save occurs at the start of each frightened creature's turn.

ability.name: Word of Recall
ability.notes: Instantly teleports willing creatures to a prepared sanctuary; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Wind Wall
ability.notes: Initial damage captured; wall blocks projectiles and small flyers but ongoing barriers are approximated.

ability.name: Wind Walk
ability.notes: Captures resistance; flying speed and transformation restrictions are not represented.

ability.name: Zone of Truth
ability.notes: Prevents deliberate lies; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Web
ability.notes: Restrains creatures entering or starting turns in webs; escape requires an action Strength check.
